requirements.text: Room creation is exposed over HTTP: the framework submits POST /rooms as player-a with a JSON body containing the fields maxPlayers, mode, and ranked.
requirements.quote: The framework submits POST /rooms as player-a with JSON {maxPlayers,mode,ranked}
acceptanceCriteria: A POST request is sent to /rooms with player-a as the requesting player.
The request body is JSON containing the fields maxPlayers, mode, and ranked.

requirements.text: For all requests in this task, mode is fixed to duel and ranked is fixed to false; these two inputs do not vary between the four tests, which differ only in maxPlayers.
requirements.quote: mode is fixed to duel; ranked is fixed to false
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four room-creation requests sends mode=duel.
Each of the four room-creation requests sends ranked=false.

requirements.text: When a room is created via POST /rooms as player-a with maxPlayers=2, mode=duel, and ranked=false, the system responds with HTTP status 201.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /rooms is submitted as player-a with maxPlayers=2, mode=duel, and ranked=false on a fresh framework fixture.
The HTTP response status code is 201.

requirements.text: When a room is created via POST /rooms as player-a with maxPlayers=8, mode=duel, and ranked=false, the system responds with HTTP status 201.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /rooms is submitted as player-a with maxPlayers=8, mode=duel, and ranked=false on a fresh framework fixture.
The HTTP response status code is 201.

requirements.text: When a room creation request is submitted via POST /rooms as player-a with maxPlayers=1, mode=duel, and ranked=false, the system responds with HTTP status 400.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /rooms is submitted as player-a with maxPlayers=1, mode=duel, and ranked=false on a fresh framework fixture.
The HTTP response status code is 400.

requirements.text: When a room creation request is submitted via POST /rooms as player-a with maxPlayers=9, mode=duel, and ranked=false, the system responds with HTTP status 400.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /rooms is submitted as player-a with maxPlayers=9, mode=duel, and ranked=false on a fresh framework fixture.
The HTTP response status code is 400.

requirements.text: The four tests are independent of one another's state: each test runs against a fresh framework fixture and creates no room shared with any other test, so no room state carries over between tests.
requirements.quote: Each test uses a fresh framework fixture and creates no shared room
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four tests executes against its own fresh framework fixture.
No room created during one test is shared with or reused by another test.
